mnemonic.meaning: Truly (真) red (赤), nothing but red. Bright red, like your face when you're embarrassed.
mnemonic.reading: MACK-A (まっか): Mack's face turns bright red when he trips on stage.

examples.ja: 恥ずかしくて顔が真っ赤になった。
examples.en: My face went bright red with embarrassment.

items.note: 真っ赤な嘘 = a complete lie. 真っ青 (まっさお) = deep blue or pale.

mnemonic.meaning: What's in the middle (中) of the body (身): its insides. The contents.
mnemonic.reading: NAH, COME ME (なかみ)? You open the box and the contents yell at you to come in.

examples.ja: 箱の中身は何ですか。
examples.en: What's inside the box?

items.note: Also figurative: 話の中身 (the substance of a talk).

mnemonic.meaning: "TON (a whole ton) DE MO NAI (とんでもない)!" A ton of cake for one person? Outrageous! Absurd!

examples.ja: とんでもない値段の時計だ。
examples.en: That watch has an outrageous price.

items.note: Also a polite reply to thanks: とんでもないです = "not at all".

mnemonic.meaning: 殴 has 殳 (weapon strike): a fist swinging like a club. To hit, to punch.
mnemonic.reading: NAG, GOO-ROO (なぐる): he nags so much you finally punch the goo out of the kangaroo.

examples.ja: 彼はかっとなって相手を殴った。
examples.en: He lost his temper and punched the other man.

items.note: 叩く (たたく) is a lighter tap or knock. 殴る is a hard hit with a fist.

mnemonic.meaning: The correct (正) body (体) under the disguise. The true identity, true form.
mnemonic.reading: SHOW TIE (しょうたい): at the end of the show, he pulls off his tie and reveals his true identity.

examples.ja: ついに犯人の正体が分かった。
examples.en: At last we found out who the culprit really was.

items.note: 正体不明 = unknown identity.

mnemonic.meaning: 穏 has 禾 (grain) + 心 (heart): a grain field and a heart at rest. Calm, gentle.
mnemonic.reading: OH, DA YACHT (おだやか) floats on a calm, gentle sea.

examples.ja: 今日は海が穏やかだ。
examples.en: The sea is calm today.

items.note: For weather, seas, people and moods. 穏やかな性格 = a gentle nature.

mnemonic.meaning: 驚 has 馬 (horse) at the bottom: the horse rears up in surprise.
mnemonic.reading: OH, DOOR, OH KEY (おどろき)! You open the door and find a surprise.

examples.ja: 彼の合格は大きな驚きだった。
examples.en: His passing was a big surprise.

items.note: Noun form of 驚く (to be surprised).

mnemonic.meaning: KITCHEN TOE (きちんと): you line up everything in the kitchen properly, neatly, exactly, even with your toe.

examples.ja: 部屋をきちんと片付けなさい。
examples.en: Tidy your room properly.

items.note: Close to ちゃんと, but more about neatness and order.

mnemonic.meaning: 謎 has 言 (words) + 迷 (lost): words that leave you lost. A riddle, a mystery.
mnemonic.reading: NAH, ZOH (なぞ)? The detective shakes his head: still a mystery.

examples.ja: その事件は今でも謎のままだ。
examples.en: That incident is still a mystery.

items.note: 謎を解く = to solve a mystery.

mnemonic.meaning: 組 is a group: you put parts together, cross your arms, team up.
mnemonic.reading: COO, MOO (くむ): a pigeon and a cow team up and put together a band.

examples.ja: 彼は腕を組んで考えていた。
examples.en: He was thinking with his arms crossed.

items.note: 足を組む = to cross your legs. 〜と組む = to team up with.

mnemonic.meaning: A hand (手) gets you to the next step (段). The way you do it: means, measure.
mnemonic.reading: SHOE DAN (しゅだん) uses any means to win: even hitting you with his shoe.

examples.ja: 目的のためなら手段を選ばない。
examples.en: He'll use any means to reach his goal.

items.note: 交通手段 = means of transport. 方法 is the general "method".

mnemonic.meaning: Breathe out (呼) and breathe in (吸). Breathing.
mnemonic.reading: COKE, CUE (こきゅう): you gulp the Coke, then stop on cue to catch your breath.

examples.ja: 深く呼吸して、落ち着いてください。
examples.en: Breathe deeply and calm down.

items.note: Also "rhythm" or "knack": 呼吸が合う (to be in sync).

mnemonic.meaning: Things (事) that come out (出) and come (来) along. Events, incidents.
mnemonic.reading: DECK, EAT, GOAT (できごと): a goat eats your deck of cards. What an event!

examples.ja: 今日の出来事を日記に書いた。
examples.en: I wrote about today's events in my diary.

items.note: 出来事 = anything that happens, big or small. 事件 = an incident (crime, scandal). イベント = an organised event.

mnemonic.meaning: The same (同) manner (様). Similar, identical.
mnemonic.reading: DOUGH, YO (どうよう): "This dough is the same as yours, yo."

examples.ja: 今年も去年と同様に暑い。
examples.en: This year is hot, same as last year.

items.note: Formal. 同じ is everyday. 同様に = likewise.

mnemonic.meaning: Move (動) and shake (揺): your insides are shaken. Agitation, being upset.
mnemonic.reading: DOUGH, YO (どうよう)! The baker is shaken: someone dropped all the dough.

examples.ja: その知らせを聞いて、彼は動揺した。
examples.en: He was shaken when he heard the news.

items.note: Emotional, not physical. 同様 (same) is a different word with the same reading.

mnemonic.meaning: BONE YAR-REE (ぼんやり): you stare absent-mindedly at a dog bone. Your mind is vague and dim.

examples.ja: 窓の外をぼんやり眺めていた。
examples.en: I was gazing blankly out the window.

items.note: For blurry sights and blank minds. ぼんやりする = to space out.

mnemonic.meaning: 掴 has 扌 (hand): your hand shoots out and grabs it.
mnemonic.reading: SKA MOO (つかむ): you grab a cow and dance ska with it.

examples.ja: 彼は私の腕を掴んだ。
examples.en: He grabbed my arm.

items.note: Also abstract: チャンスを掴む (seize a chance), 心を掴む (win someone's heart).

mnemonic.meaning: 沈 has 氵 (water): something goes under the water. To sink.
mnemonic.reading: SHE ZOOMS (しずむ) down to the bottom of the pool. She sinks like a rock.

examples.ja: 太陽が西に沈んだ。
examples.en: The sun set in the west.

items.note: 気分が沈む = to feel down. Transitive: 沈める (to sink something).

mnemonic.meaning: 覆 has 襾 (cover) on top: a lid covering something. To cover, to hide.
mnemonic.reading: OH, OOH (おおう)! The magician covers the rabbit with a cloth. Gone!

examples.ja: 雪が町を覆った。
examples.en: Snow covered the town.

items.note: Often for big areas or hiding something: 顔を覆う (cover your face).

mnemonic.meaning: BOOTS CAR RUE (ぶつかる): your boots slip, and your car bumps into a wall. Collision!

examples.ja: 自転車が車にぶつかった。
examples.en: A bicycle ran into a car.

items.note: Also for problems: 問題にぶつかる (run into a problem). Transitive: ぶつける (Level 5).

mnemonic.meaning: 少 is a little, and 々 repeats it: a little little. Just a moment, a few.
mnemonic.reading: SHOW-SHOW (しょうしょう): "Wait a little, the show is about to start."

examples.ja: 少々お待ちください。
examples.en: Please wait a moment.

items.note: Polite version of 少し. Very common in shops and on the phone.

mnemonic.meaning: Investigate (調) and inspect (査). An investigation, a survey.
mnemonic.reading: CHOW, SAW (ちょうさ): the detective investigates who sawed through the chow table.

examples.ja: 事故の原因を調査している。
examples.en: They are investigating the cause of the accident.

items.note: 調べる is the everyday verb. 調査 is for formal studies and polls.

mnemonic.meaning: 満 is full: the bath fills up to the top. To be full.
mnemonic.reading: ME, CHEER, RUE (みちる): the stadium fills up until I can't cheer anymore.

examples.ja: 彼の顔は自信に満ちていた。
examples.en: His face was full of confidence.

items.note: Often 〜に満ちる / 満ちた: 希望に満ちた (full of hope). Formal and literary.

mnemonic.meaning: Male (男) child (子). A boy, a young man.
mnemonic.reading: DAN, SHE (だんし)? No, Dan is a boy.

examples.ja: 男子学生は三十人いる。
examples.en: There are thirty male students.

items.note: 男子 / 女子 are used for students and sports teams: 男子トイレ (men's room).

mnemonic.meaning: MO' SHE, MO' (もしも)... If she comes, in case she brings more friends, supposing...

examples.ja: もしも宝くじが当たったら、何をする?
examples.en: If you won the lottery, what would you do?

items.note: Stronger, more dramatic もし. もしものとき = in an emergency.

mnemonic.meaning: 硬 has 石 (stone): hard as a stone. Hard, stiff.
mnemonic.reading: CAT, EYE (かたい): the cat's eye is hard as glass.

examples.ja: このパンは硬くて食べにくい。
examples.en: This bread is hard and difficult to eat.

items.note: Three kanji for かたい: 硬い (hard material), 固い (firm, solid), 堅い (steady, serious).

mnemonic.meaning: 願 has 頁 (head): you bow your head and make a wish. A request, a hope.
mnemonic.reading: NEIGH, GUY (ねがい): the horse neighs its wish to the guy: one more carrot.

examples.ja: 私の願いは家族の健康です。
examples.en: My wish is for my family's health.

items.note: Noun from 願う. お願い = a favour, please.

mnemonic.meaning: Your mind (意) thinks (思) and decides. Your will, your intention.
mnemonic.reading: EASY (いし): it's easy once you have the will to do it.

examples.ja: 本人の意思を尊重する。
examples.en: We respect the person's own wishes.

items.note: 意思 = intention. 意志 (also いし) = willpower. Both are common.

mnemonic.meaning: MASS, MASS (ますます): the mass keeps getting bigger. More and more, increasingly.

examples.ja: 雨がますます強くなってきた。
examples.en: The rain is getting heavier and heavier.

items.note: Usually with a change: ますます〜なる.

mnemonic.meaning: TAP, PUREE (たっぷり): you tap the jar and plenty of puree pours out. A lot!

examples.ja: 時間はたっぷりあるから、急がなくていい。
examples.en: We have plenty of time, so no need to hurry.

items.note: Generous amounts: たっぷり寝る, クリームたっぷりのケーキ.
